subject: [RFC PATCH 04/18] mm: count the pages waiting for a grace period

2026-10-19.patch_summary: This patch adds a new counter to track pages waiting for an RCU (Read-Copy Update) grace period. These pages have a refcount of zero and are not on the free lists, making them invisible to existing counters. The new counter, NR_FREE_RCU_PAGES, is added to the /proc/vmstat output and show_free_areas() function. This change prepares for freeing these waiting pages sooner when they hold back needed memory.
